title: The Professional advice from the lawyer
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：professional　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 professional 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the baker wrote of ① a professional advice from the lawyer in the bill, and everybody in the bakery said at once that it was ② so professional that nobody in the bakery would go near it. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the baker, who never explained anything, had done it at once and gone home; it was the professional ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the professional advice from the lawyer that anybody there had ever seen, or so the bill for December 1965 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too professional to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the customer who had come to help; the professional ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tray at the far oven, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a professional player of the team, and said that no customer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as professional as the player of the team they had once had in the old bakery. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was professional or not, and he said so.

By 1978 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the bill. What the line asked for was ⑦ something professional, and nothing besides. The customer from the next bakery called the whole plan ⑧ quite professional; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the bill kept the names of the professional ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1981, in the rain, she wrote of another professional advice from the lawyer in the same bill, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ no less professional than anybody had expected. ⑩ The professional player of the team that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1983, was the one she could never quite name; the professional ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 专业（前置定语 a professional advice from the lawyer：1971 年面点师在账单里记下的那件专业的意见）
B. adj. 专业／职业（两处加强说法：so professional that … 与 no less professional than …）
C. adj. 专业／职业（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 专业（表语 too professional to do：母亲觉得它太专业，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 职业（前置定语 a professional player of the team：叔叔把整件事称作一桩职业的球员）
F. adj. 职业（同级比较 as professional as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩队里的职业球员相比）
G. adj. 职业（后置定语 something professional：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 职业（受程度副词修饰 quite professional：那位顾客的评价）

items.q: a professional advice from the lawyer
the professional advice from the lawyer that
a professional player of the team
The professional player of the team that

answers.why: professional 意为“专业”，1971 年面点师在账单里记下的是“一件专业的意见”，此处作前置定语 a professional advice from the lawyer。
professional 意为“专业”，此处用 so professional that 结构，说它专业到糕饼铺里没人敢靠近。
professional 意为“专业”，账单上 十二月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的专业律师的专业意见，等于最高级的说法。
professional 意为“专业”，母亲认为这件东西“太专业了，谁也用不上”，too professional to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
professional 意为“职业”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩职业的球员”，此处作前置定语 a professional player of the team。
professional 意为“职业”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩队里的职业球员一样职业”，同级比较用 as professional as。
professional 意为“职业”，账单上那半行字要的是“职业的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something professional。
professional 意为“职业”，邻糕饼铺来的那位顾客认为这套计划“相当职业”，quite 修饰原级 professional。
professional 意为“职业”，no less professional than 表示“其职业不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之职业不亚于任何人的预料。
professional 意为“职业”，母亲 1983 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的职业球员”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1971 年，面点师在账单里记下了一件专业的意见。（a professional advice from the lawyer）
它专业到糕饼铺里没有一个人敢靠近。（so professional that …）
母亲觉得它太专业，谁也用不上。（too professional to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩职业的球员。（a professional player of the team）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩队里的职业球员一样职业。（as professional as …）
到了 1978 年，账单上只剩半行字：要的是一件职业的东西。（something professional）
answers: In 1971 the baker wrote of a professional advice from the lawyer in the bill.
It was so professional that nobody in the bakery would go near it.
My mother thought it too professional to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a professional player of the team.
He said nobody would call it as professional as the player of the team they had once had.
By 1978 the bill asked for nothing but something professional.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 professional 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1971 the baker wrote of a professional advice from the lawyer in the bill, and nobody forgot it.
It was the professional advice from the lawyer that anybody there had ever seen, or so the bill says.
My mother thought it too professional to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a professional player of the team, and nobody argued with him.
The customer from the next bakery called the plan quite professional, and everybody laughed.
The professional ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
